title: IIT Patna Notification 2026 - Apply for 02 Senior Research Fellow and Project Assistant Posts
description: Indian Institute of Technology Patna (IIT Patna) has announced the official notification for the recruitment of 02 Senior Research Fellow and Project Assistant Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in B.E/ B.Tech, M.E/ M.Tech in Civil Engineering, B.Sc, or M.Sc can grab this chance and apply for the IIT Patna Notification 2026 . Here, we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible...
